info.name: PhonePe PG Native OTP
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway - Native OTP APIs.

Introduction: Native OTP lets you keep the customer on your own page during card authentication instead of redirecting to the bank/3DS page - you collect the OTP in your UI and submit it via API. First initiate a card payment (Custom Checkout Pay API) with the extra "nativeOtp" flag enabled, then Submit OTP / Resend OTP here.

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Native OTP -> Submit OTP, Resend OTP
- Webhooks (Mock Server)

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically.

Environments:
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/<Endpoint>
- Production: Authorization API https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/<Endpoint> ; Other APIs https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg/<Endpoint>

API Endpoints:
- Authorization  POST /v1/oauth/token
- Submit OTP     POST /payments/v2/native-otp/submit
- Resend OTP     POST /payments/v2/native-otp/resend

Note: The card payment itself is created via the Custom Checkout Pay API with the additional "nativeOtp" parameter - see the Custom Checkout collection and https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/sample-payload

Docs:
- Native OTP: https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp
- Authorization: https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/authorization
- Submit OTP: https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/submit-otp
- Resend OTP: https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/resend-otp
- Sample Payload: https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/sample-payload
- UAT Sandbox: https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/uat-sandbox

exec: throw new Error('Missing access_token. Run Authorization/Get Access Token first.');

request.description: Generate the O-Bearer access token required to authenticate the Native OTP APIs. https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/authorization

Submit the OTP entered by the customer to complete card authentication. Success returns HTTP 200 (attemptsLeft: null). Failure returns code INVALID_OTP_TOKEN / REQUEST_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED with attemptsLeft. https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/submit-otp
Request a new OTP if the customer did not receive the first one. Success returns HTTP 200 with attemptsLeft. https://developer.phonepe.com/native-otp/resend-otp

item.name: Webhooks (Mock Server)
item.description: Native OTP payments surface their final status through the standard PG order webhook / order status. Right-click this folder -> Mock Collection to create a Postman mock server, then set mock_base_url and webhook_auth_sha256.
